posts.t:
Noah Cates acknowledged that ANA's first goal -- the bad handoff between Woll & Seeler --  "deflated" the team a bit.

"Guys got to step up and say, we're playing fine. One goal, it's whatever. We're still in the lead. We're still got ahold of this game if we play the right way."
Flyers pull Woll with 2:07 left after an icing and a timeout. 6-on-5 now.

Eeeeeesh. Joseph Woll just gave up a horrendous goal to Tristan Luneau. 4-3.

I guess that evens out the Foerster goal, but yikes. Flyers trailing for the first time today.
Joseph Woll just absolutely robbed Cutter Gauthier. TWICE. Monster saves on Public Enemy No. 1 in Philadelphia.

“He’s jumping on loose pucks. Those goals were just goal-scorer’s goals. And he’s skating well.”

Matvei Michkov is heating up, and Joseph Woll continues to impress.

🎁 My story from last night's win, free to read:
www.nytimes.com/athletic/770...

threads.t: Joseph Woll grand larceny not once, but twice on Gauthier.
